shortDescription: Set permission details for a specific section

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: groupPermissions
options.description: List of group permissions to set for this section Each item should contain group name, canView, canModify, and canDelete

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: section
options.description: The name of the section to set permissions for Should match a section name from the list permissions API call

options.name: userPermissions
options.description: List of user permissions to set for this section Each item should contain username, canView, canModify, and canDelete

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests
